data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your June 30, 2026 13F shows positions in CPHC, ALCO, and IPI.

A new Schedule 13D for CPHC was filed on October 1, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1672909/000139834426017759/0001398344-26-017759-index.htm).

I publish a free weekly issue from public records, and can offer a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
